data.text: Connect two Stats of two friendly subjects (draw the chosen element value as dice and put over the card). The sum becomes the new Stat value.

natural_permanent.text: Monster natural permanent (Loxodon Mystic starts with 2, power 6 each): the monster is linked to its nearest allied creature — with both copies standing that is the ∀ double cast, all four of that creature's stats are added to its own; with one copy left only its Vitality; a lone monster gets nothing. A destroyed copy goes to the monster's archive (Rule 24, World). Players still cast Spirit Link on an ally stat.

logic.description: Implemented (2026-10-29). The clicked ally stat (else the biggest stat among my living allies) is added to my stat while the permanent stands — not a token, so it overrides nothing; my life maximum follows (general_ux_hitpoints_calculations). ∀: all four stats. Natural: the holder (after every action, its own state) links to its nearest living allied creature (distance, then id) — with both copies standing it is the ∀ double cast: all four of that creature's stats are added to its own (links_json, every_csv); with one copy left a plain Vitality link; a lone monster has no link. The link moves to whichever allied creature is nearest. Monster natural permanent (user rulings 2026-11-15, rule_monster_natural_permanents): a monster whose creature card has this innate effect starts with 2 copies already cast — one permanent id in permanents_csv plus a copy count in perm_copies_json, power 6 each (perm_power_json), both cards in its permanents holding (they count toward DECK_MIN), none in its deck, never cast (not in its deck, and destroyed copies are archived, so npcCastChoice never sees it). Rule 24 (a die of 6 of the stat of the effect's elements) destroys ONE copy per success (dropPermanent decrements, the destroyed copy's card goes to the monster's ARCHIVE — out of circulation); the effect lasts until both are gone. Wild monsters only (no companion / summon / human or npc_b hero); a restart / rejoin boots with exactly 2 again. Players still cast it as described first; the natural reading applies only to a monster's starting copies.

prerequisites.description: Only Posture / Empty Posture emit the elements of a non-instant cast (Rule 20).
No element of the cast is barred for the caster by a fired Disable (Rule 20 pc override).
The linked unit is a living ally (any distance).

effects.description: My stat while linked = my base stat + the ally's current base stat for the chosen stat.
How many stats are linked: 1, all 4 on a ∀ double cast.
Rule 12: the permanent is placed with a point-buy die (re-rolled until the sum fits); that die is its power under Rule 24.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys this permanent when it is at least the token value behind the cast element.
Natural: the nearest allied creature's stat is added to the holder's — all four with 2 copies (∀), Vitality with 1.
Rule 24: an enemy point-buy die of the matching stat destroys ONE copy when it is at least 6.

validation.description: element_cost stays non-empty and still carries elem_souls (the element family that defines the effect).
The number of elements stays within ±1 of the canonical cost.
The ∀ double-cast bonus text stays present (the engine unlocks it on a Rule 23 chained cast).
The natural_permanent block (copies, power, semantics) stays.
